evals.prompt: Add a business-level tenant-isolation review obligation to an existing plan without changing its target.
evals.expected_output: Reads the Markdown projection, creates a constrained draft, changes only the relevant vector obligations, reseals a new plan pair, and reports its paths.

evals.prompt: Convert this audit plan to YAML so our reviewers can edit it more easily.
evals.expected_output: Declines YAML as an executable format, keeps sealed JSON canonical, and offers the Markdown projection plus draft/reseal workflow.

evals.prompt: Change the plan to inspect a different repository and run the audit afterwards.
evals.expected_output: Stops because changing target binding requires a new plan run and because plan authoring must not run an audit or open target source.
